title: Recitation with the rubric: Al-Muddaththir 1 to 30: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Muddaththir and madd in recitation
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Recitation with the rubric rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 18. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
the checklist used to assess recitation

questions.q: Recite 74:18 to 23 and say which word starts each ayah.
How many ayat in 74:18 to 23 start with ثُمَّ?
Breakout pairs: recite 74:1 to 30 to a partner who scores the rubric (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites 74:11 to 30 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric with one target; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: write the meaning of 74:26 to 30 in your own words.
questions.a: Allah will drive him into Saqar, which leaves nothing; over it are nineteen (angels).

questions.q: Think again: What is the difference between reciting from memory and reciting well from memory?
questions.a: Well means accurate letters, rules, even madd, steady pace and good stops: the rubric rows.
